- Billing entity: Greenfield Finance, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789). Finance requires invoices with PO number and remit to: accounts.payable@greenfield.com.
- Contract review: Our legal will run a standard review; they typically request the vendor’s standard MSA and an SOW.

One wrinkle: for vendors that handle sensitive data we route a quick IT security intake first; Mark is cc’d here and will confirm the timeline.

I’ll fill the rest of the intake form and return it by Monday. Procurement’s ballpark timeline: procurement + finance approvals usually take 2–3 weeks once we have a final SOW and pricing. Legal review another ~5 business days.
